Landed on main as 67c10e8; just ready green (clippy -D warnings, fmt, 850 workspace tests, lat check), all 6 E2E scripts green in Docker. Also fixed missing libdbus-1-3 in Dockerfile.func that was breaking the func suite.

Landed d3e8d32. Root cause was two-fold: the E2E scripts drove the retired OSC 1337 transport with a structurally impossible readback, AND the client never handled AiStateChanged/AiStateCleared/PromptReceived. Both fixed; both scripts now pass and are in just e2e. Gate green on 771794d (870 tests).

Landed e4a0ac7. Root cause: workspace enabled zbus's compile-time-exclusive 'tokio' feature, which Cargo feature-unification applied to GPUI's own zbus consumers (accesskit_unix, ashpd, oo7) running on non-Tokio threads. Dropped the feature; zero reactor panics on launch; notifications verified working via dbus-monitor.

Landed f56ef95. Root cause: keybinding dispatch and CreateSession were never wired into the live path (referenced only by unit tests); tab row was a hardcoded single TabData. Wired the tabs-and-windows action family with live repro evidence. Note: pane/workspace/navigation/zoom actions remain intercepted no-ops - tracked in .58/.59.

Landed a50a5f2. Terminal window now owns a ConfigRuntime keeping the notify watcher alive; theme, chrome, grid font, cell metrics, and keybindings reapply live with no restart (same pid, same window), and ConfigReloaded is emitted. Also added the missing tracing_subscriber - the crate's tracing output was previously discarded entirely.

Landed 771794d. Implemented opacity: WindowBackgroundAppearance::Transparent (unconditional, so opacity is a pure repaint with no restart), alpha derived from clamped config across grid/tab-bar/status/prompt bands, theme-ignoring hardcoded color also fixed. Pixel-proven: grid (30,30,30)->(64,26,64) at 0.85, matching expected blend.

Verification satisfied by .56's implementation evidence: bleed-through pixel-confirmed on the composited RTX 3090 display (grid (30,30,30)->(64,26,64), tab bar (45,45,45)->(76,38,76); diff bbox (4,40,964,720) vs None before), live reload without restart across 5 config edits at identical pid/window id, and clamping of 1.5/-0.2 without crash. Original llvmpipe hypothesis refuted - client runs on NVIDIA.
